front_knee_at_load.definition: left knee interior angle at deepest bend

back_knee_at_load.definition: right knee interior angle at deepest bend

bend_duration.definition: time from mean knee angle last above 150 deg to deepest bend

extend_duration.definition: time from deepest bend until mean knee angle first exceeds 160 deg

front_knee_drive_speed.definition: peak front-knee straightening speed within 350 ms after deepest bend

load_to_reach.definition: time from deepest bend to highest right wrist (contact proxy)

trophy_upperarm_elevation.definition: right elbow-shoulder-hip angle at deepest bend (trophy): how high the hitting elbow is lifted

trophy_toss_height.definition: left wrist height above shoulder midpoint at deepest bend, in trunk lengths

arm_fold_lead.definition: how long before the deepest bend the hitting elbow folds below 45 deg and stays folded (arm-leg timing)

contact_elbow_extension.definition: hitting elbow angle at contact proxy

contact_hand_height.definition: hitting wrist height above shoulders at contact proxy

camera_model.yaw_reference: hip line (H36M L-R hip) at 3D deepest-knee frame
camera_model.yaw_meaning: 0 = camera behind the right hip looking along the hip line (profile); |90| = square-on; positive yaw = left hip appears to the right of the right hip in the image
camera_model.chirality: source x negated before projection (mmpose demo reflection undone)

limitations: Reference 3D is itself estimated from broadcast video
Events are body-landmark proxies without video confirmation
